script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars, your ruling fire planet, sits in Virgo forming a tense square to Neptune in Pisces, rattling your 6th House of work and 12th House of secrets. Venus in Gemini trines your 1st House of self, making you magnetic but slippery in love—singles attract a witty air sign if they speak first. Taken Aries: watch for vague excuses from a partner under this fog. In career, that Mars-Neptune square disrupts your 2nd House of money; delay signing contracts until July 22. Blessing: a surprise debt clears via an unexpected 8th House refund. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
